The quoted oracle itself reads “Zion will be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps” (web:Jer.26.18), rendering צִיּ֞וֹן שָׂדֶ֤ה תֵֽחָרֵשׁ֙ וִירוּשָׁלַ֨יִם֙ עִיִּ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה (oshb:Jer.26.18, byte tier) -- Jerusalem spelled plene here, וִירוּשָׁלַ֨יִם֙, against the vav-prefixed defective וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם (oshb:Jer.27.21, byte tier; also at oshb:Jer.27.20), the conjunction now held constant with the mater as the remaining difference between the pair. The elders draw the historical conclusion at 26:19: Hezekiah did not put Micah to death, so the present assembly should not put Jeremiah to death either. Whether this testimony belongs inside the same row as the princes' own hearing (26:10-16) or opens its own unit, as here, is a close call this tiling does not treat as settled.
